title: What’s New in MiiTuber 0.2.1
items: Fixed the OBS Clean View so switching between full-body and head-only display stays in sync with the main window.
Removed the unused GLB rendering fallback and its networking and hashing dependencies.
Changed the Mii thumbnails (Credit Arian Kordi)
footer:
The macOS build is unsigned and not notarized. On first launch, Control-click MiiTuber, choose Open, and confirm Open. If it is still blocked, allow MiiTuber under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

NOTE: Mii Creator custom features do not work with MiiTuber.
